about: The typecheck wall (tools/gate/src/lib/typecheck.ts): every program tsc runs, every tracked .ts that no program loads (excused, by name, with a reason), and the per-file type-error DEBT that predates the wall (baseline). The baseline may only SHRINK. The compiler is the native TypeScript 7 build the console already builds with (console/package.json @typescript/native): 0.15 s on tools/gate against 1.2 s for the root 5.9 tsc, same diagnostics.
